## Signal-Noise Ratio

+ Plot correlation between this and accuracy?
+ Mu(1+theta)/sigma from the real/actual data.
+ Detection Accuracy curve (0 - "Now we can see it") -- activation curve... just noticable difference (how low can you go until it is not noticable?)

## Read in Participant Data

```{r}
all_data_clean <- read_csv("changepoint-lineup-participant-data.csv") |> 
  mutate(across(lineup_id:version, ~ as.factor(.x)),
         direction = fct_relevel(direction, c("Positive", "Negative"))
         )
```

```{r}
# labellers for plotting

sigma_level <- c(
  "1" = "Low Variance",
  "2" = "High Variance"
)

cploc_level <- c(
  "0.333333333" = "Early Change",
  "0.5" = "Middle Change",
  "0.666666667" = "Late Change"
)

theta_level <- c(
  "-5" = "- High Shift",
  "-3" = "- Moderate Shift",
  "-1" = "- Low Shift",
  "5" = "+ High Shift",
  "3" = "+ Moderate Shift",
  "1" = "+ Low Shift"
)

theta_level2 <- c(
  "5" = "High Shift",
  "3" = "Moderate Shift",
  "1" = "Low Shift"
)

correct_level <- c(
  "0" = "Incorrect Target Identification",
  "1" = "Correct Target Identification"
)
```

```{r}
                         "31-40" = "36-40",
                         "41-50" = "41-45",

                         ">60" = "Over 60",

                         ),
```

## Binomial GLMM

| Source of Variation                               | Degrees of Freedom (2520 - 1) = 2519 |
|---------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| participant_id                                    | (210 - 1) = 209                      |
| theta                                             | (3 - 1) = 5                          |
| direction                                         | (2 - 1) = 1                          |
| cpLoc                                             | (3 - 1) = 2                          |
| sigma                                             | (2 - 1) = 1                          |
| theta x direction                                 | (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2                   |
| theta x cpLoc                                     | (3 - 1)(3 - 1) = 4                   |
| theta x sigma                                     | (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2                   |
| direction x cpLoc                                 | (3 - 1)(3 - 1) = 4                   |
| directionigma                                     | (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2                   |
| cpLoc x sigma                                     | (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2                   |
| theta x cpLoc x sigma                             | (6 - 1)(3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 10           |
| participant_id x theta x cpLoc x sigma - residual | ... = 2275                           |
|                                                   |                                      |

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)

mod <- glmer(correct ~ direction*theta_abs*sigma*cpLoc + (1 | participant_id),
             family = binomial(),
             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 20000)
             ),
             data = all_data_clean
             )
```

```{r}
car::Anova(mod)
anova(mod)
```

## Identification Accuracy

### Descriptive results

```{r}
identification_accuracy1 <- all_data_clean |> 
  dplyr::select(participant_id, version, cpLoc, sigma, theta, correct, response_no, obs_plot_location) |> 
  mutate(correct = factor(correct)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             fill = correct)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat     = "count", 
           position = "fill") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = labeller(sigma = sigma_level,
                                 cpLoc = cploc_level
                                 )
             ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = theta_level) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#D3D3D3", "steelblue")) +
```

## Shift Magnitude and Variance

```{r}
magnitude_odds_level <- c(
  "theta_abs5 / theta_abs1" = "High / Low Shift",
  "theta_abs3 / theta_abs1" = "Moderate / Low Shift",
  "theta_abs5 / theta_abs3" = "High / Moderate Shift"
)


library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)

magnitude_odds <- emmeans(mod, ~ theta_abs | sigma, type = "response", adjust = "dunnet") |>
  # cld(Letters = letters, 
  #     adjust = "sidak", 
  #     alpha = 0.05)
  pairs(infer = c(T,T), reverse = TRUE) |> 
  # emmeans::cld.emmGrid()
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(contrast = fct_relevel(contrast,  
                                c("theta_abs5 / theta_abs3",
                                  "theta_abs3 / theta_abs1",
                                  "theta_abs5 / theta_abs1"
                                  )
                                )
        ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = contrast
             )
         ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = odds.ratio), 
             position = position_dodge(0.6),
             size = 2
             ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = asymp.LCL, 
                    xmax = asymp.UCL
                    ), 
                width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(0.6)
                ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, 
             color = "darkgray", 
             linetype = "dashed"
             ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = magnitude_odds_level) +
  facet_wrap(~ sigma, ncol = 1,
             labeller = labeller(sigma = sigma_level)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.25) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12)
        ) +
  labs(y = "",
       x = "(Log) Odds Ratio",
       title = "Accuracy between Magnitude Shift Levels") +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma)

magnitude_odds
# ggsave(plot = magnitude_odds, filename = here("results", plot = "magnitude_OR.png"), width = 6, height = 4)
```

## Selection Reason

```{r}
selection_overall <- all_data_clean |> 
  mutate(cluster=stringr::str_count(choice_reason,"Clustering"),
         slope = stringr::str_count(choice_reason, "slope"),
         range = stringr::str_count(choice_reason, "range"),
         outlier=stringr::str_count(choice_reason, "Outlier"),
         shape=stringr::str_count(choice_reason, "shape")
  ) |> 
  group_by(correct) |> 
  summarize(cluster=sum(cluster),
            slope=sum(slope),
            range=sum(range),
            outlier=sum(outlier),
            shape=sum(shape)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols=cluster:shape,
               names_to="response",
               values_to="count") |> 
  group_by(correct) |> 
  mutate(pct= count/sum(count)) |> 
  arrange(correct, -count) |> 
  mutate(correct = factor(correct, levels = c(0,1))) |> 
  mutate(response = factor(response, levels = c("outlier", "cluster", "slope", "range", "shape"))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = pct,
             y = response,
             group = correct,
             fill = correct)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge2(1)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct*100, 1), "%")),
            position = position_dodge2(0.9),
            hjust = -0.1,
            size = 3.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "",
       x = "",
       title = str_c("Proportion of Lineups with each Choice Reasoning selected <br> for ", "<span style = 'color:steelblue'>**Correct**</span>", " and ", 
       "<span style = 'color:#A9A9A9'>**Incorrect**</span>", " Evaluations")) +
  theme(plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12)
        ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,0.5), labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#D3D3D3", "steelblue"))
selection_overall

# ggsave(plot = selection_overall, filename = here("results", plot = "selection-overall.png"), width = 6, height = 4)
```

## Confidence

```{r}
library(ggmosaic)

conf_lowvar <- all_data_clean |> 
  filter(sigma == 1) |> 
  mutate(conf_level = factor(conf_level, levels = c("Strongly Disagree", "Disagree", "Neutral", "Agree", "Strongly Agree"))) |> 
  mutate(correct = factor(correct, levels = c(1,0), labels = c("Correct", "Incorrect"))) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_mosaic(aes(x = product(correct),
             fill = conf_level),
             show.legend = T,
             color = "black") +
  facet_nested(cpLoc ~ sigma + theta,
             labeller = labeller(sigma = sigma_level,
                                 cpLoc = cploc_level,
                                 theta = theta_level)
             ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "PuOr",
                    guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(y = "",
       x = "Evaluation",
       fill = "I am confident \nin my answer...") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
        )
conf_lowvar

  labs(y = "",
       x = "Evaluation",
       fill = "I am confident \nin my answer...") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12)
        ) 
conf_highvar
# ggsave(plot = conf_highvar, filename = here("results", plot = "conf-levels-highvar.png"), width = 10, height = 4)
```

## Target changepoint comparison analysis

::: callout-note
I used the `changepoint` package to test for a change in mean in the data set. The `cpt.mean()` package tested this using the AMOC method, which was suitable for data with a single change point.
:::

```{r}
if(require("changepoint")){
    print("changepoint is loaded correctly")
} else {
    print("trying to install changepoint")
    install.packages("changepoint")
    if(require(changepoint)){
        print("changepoint installed and loaded")
    } else {
        stop("could not install changepoint")
    }
}
```

```{r}
files <- list.files(path = "data", full.names = T)
df <- files |> 
  map_dfr(read_csv) 

pic_details <- read_csv("data/picture_details.csv") |> 
  rename(picid = lineup_id) |> 
  dplyr::select(picid, theta, cpLoc, sigma, version)
```

```{r}
cploc_CPD <- function(x){
  cpt.mean(x, method="AMOC",class=FALSE)->cploc # <1>
  cploc |> as.numeric()
}

mean_diff <- function(x){
  cpt.mean(x, method="AMOC",class=TRUE)->cploc 
  param.est(cploc)$mean |> diff() |> as.numeric()
}

cp_test_results <- df |> 
  filter(panel=="target") |>
  group_by(picid) |> 
  summarize(change_point = cploc_CPD(value)[1],
            confvalue = cploc_CPD(value)[2] |> round(4)#,
            # shift_size = mean_diff(value) |> round(1)
) |> 
  mutate(CP_detected = case_when(change_point==30 | confvalue <0.90~"No", # <2>
                                 .default="Yes")) |> # <2> 
ungroup()

cp_test_results |> left_join(pic_details,by="picid") |>  #<3>
  # relocate(shift_size,.before= theta) |> 
  mutate(visual_changepoint = round(30*cpLoc,2)) |> 
  relocate(visual_changepoint,.before = change_point) -> cp_test_results

cp_test_results
```

### Confidence Value Plots

```{r}
confvalue_plt <- cp_test_results |> 
filter(theta!=0) |> # <1>
mutate(Location=case_when(visual_changepoint == 10~"Early",
                visual_changepoint == 15~"Middle",
                visual_changepoint == 20~"Late"),
          MagDir = case_when(theta ==-5 ~"- High", theta ==5 ~"+ High", theta==3~ "+ Medium", theta==-3~ "- Medium", theta == 1~" + Low", theta == - 1~" - Low"),
          Variance = case_when(sigma==1~"Low",sigma==2~"High"))  |> 
mutate(MagDir = factor(MagDir, levels=c("- High","- Medium"," - Low"," + Low","+ Medium","+ High")),
Variance = factor(Variance,levels=c("Low","High")),
Location = factor(Location,levels=c("Early","Middle","Late"))) |> 
dplyr::select(confvalue,CP_detected,Location,MagDir,Variance,version)

comp <- confvalue_plt |>
left_join(prop_correct_df, 
          by = c("MagDir","Variance","Location","version")
          )
```


```{r}
changepoint <- comp |> 
ggplot(aes(x = confvalue,
           y = prop_correct)
       ) + 
geom_point(aes(shape = MagDir),
           size = 3
           ) +
geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5) + 
geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5) + 
facet_grid(Location ~ Variance,
           labeller = label_both)+
theme_bw() +
theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      aspect.ratio = 1
      ) +
scale_shape_manual(values=c(3,4,0,16,17,18))+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
labs(x = "Change Point Analysis Confidence",
     subtitle = "Identification Probability",
     title = "",
     y = ""
     ) 
changepoint
# ggsave(plot = changepoint, filename = here("results", plot = "changepoint.png"), width = 6, height = 8)
```
